methods.scaling_rule: required = minimum x team games played / 17
methods.scaling_text: Each minimum is a full-season (17-game) bar set by the owner after reviewing the leader reliability study's curves; the study did not choose them. The bar scales with the games played by the player's current team: required = minimum x team games played / 17. For example, after 12 team games the passing-rate bar is about 176 dropbacks. Season totals have no minimum.
methods.traded_players: A traded player's sample counts every game he played this season, for any team, and is held to the bar of the team he played for most recently (his team in his latest game in that card's source).
methods.ranking: Highest figure leads, except sack rate and interception rate, where the lowest figure leads. Totals are ranked as season totals. Ties share a rank.
methods.impact_note: Total EPA is the impact measure; football has no RAPM and no new model is fitted. Each player is credited with the EPA of his own plays, using the study's fields: nflfastR qb_epa on his dropbacks as passer (pass attempts, sacks and scrambles), epa on his designed carries, and epa on his targets as receiver, summed. A completed pass credits both the passer and the receiver in full, so totals across players do not sum to team EPA. Two-point tries and kneels are excluded.
methods.noise_note: Interception rate, completion % over expected, EPA per carry, rushing success rate and EPA per target are mostly noise at season sample sizes (study: interception rate, EPA per carry and rushing success rate never reach 0.5 reliability; completion % over expected is about 0.34 at 150 dropbacks; EPA per target about 0.13 at 30 targets).
methods.definitions: Dropbacks: plays with qb_dropback = 1 (pass attempts, sacks, scrambles), credited to the passer. Designed carries: run plays with rush_attempt = 1, excluding QB scrambles and kneels, credited to the rusher. Targets: pass attempts (not sacks) with a listed receiver. Two-point tries are excluded throughout. Games played: games with at least one offensive snap in the snap counts. Success = EPA above zero; completion % over expected is nflfastR's cpoe in percentage points.
methods.refresh: Cards update in the 09:00 pipeline run and in the evening score refreshes. The total EPA card is model-based and updates in the 09:00 run only. Each card shows its own through date.
methods.sample: Regular-season games of the current season only. There is no fallback to last season.
methods.not_available: Yards per route run is not shown: nflverse does not record routes run for every receiver.
